title: fix: refine model ID announcements
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Reworks the News announcement with consistent bullets, link behavior, and inline model ID colors.
- Uses the model test-tube emoji and separates the example with simple dividers.
- Gives the Models notice a neutral elevated surface with nectar-accented links and no borders.
- Verifies the Enter frontend with `npm run typecheck`.

gist.headline: Model IDs, properly labeled
gist.blurb: The news hive got a small editorial cleanup: model IDs now stand out, links behave consistently, and the test tube has found its rightful place.
gist.summary: Refined the Enter frontend's News and Models announcements with consistent bullet lists and links, color-coded inline model IDs, a test-tube example divider, and a neutral elevated Models notice surface.
gist.impact: Users browsing Enter announcements can more easily spot and copy the relevant model IDs while reading cleaner, more consistent update notices.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a meticulous lab assistant in a cozy garden laboratory, arranging glowing model-ID labels beside a tiny test tube and a neat bulletin board. Use code-plants and nectar-colored link ribbons to represent clearer model announcements and navigation.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden laboratory where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink blush, light blue wings, and tiny round scientist glasses, carefully pins colorful model-ID labels onto a clean bulletin board beside a glowing test tube; code-plants bloom from pots and soft nectar-colored link ribbons connect the notes. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with small pixel-font text: 'MODEL ID'.
